scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @k-one/api && npm run build -w @k-one/worker && npm run build -w @k-one/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @k-one/api && npm run typecheck -w @k-one/worker && npm run typecheck -w @k-one/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @k-one/api && npm run lint -w @k-one/worker && npm run lint -w @k-one/web
scripts.dev:infra: cd infra && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d
scripts.dev: npm run dev:infra && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n api,worker,web -c cyan,yellow,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.stop:infra: cd infra && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml down
